mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_kind AS ownerKind, owner_code AS ownerCode, key_cipher AS keyCipher, key_mask AS keyMask, status, cooldown_until AS cooldownUntil, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM credential WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, owner_kind AS ownerKind, owner_code AS ownerCode, key_cipher AS keyCipher, key_mask AS keyMask, status, cooldown_until AS cooldownUntil, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM credential WHERE owner_kind = #{ownerKind} AND owner_code = #{ownerCode} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credential (owner_kind, owner_code, key_cipher, key_mask, status) VALUES (#{ownerKind}, #{ownerCode}, #{keyCipher}, #{keyMask}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'available'))
mapper.update: UPDATE credential SET cooldown_until = GREATEST(COALESCE(cooldown_until, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), #{cooldownUntil}), status = 'cooldown' WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'disabled'
mapper.select: SELECT owner_code AS ownerCode, SUM(status = 'available') AS availableCount FROM credential WHERE owner_kind = 'provider' GROUP BY owner_code
